signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.phoneHint: The number you registered with, for example 077 123 4567.
signIn.forgotten: Forgotten your password? Ask a librarian at your branch to reset it.

changePassword.title: Change password
changePassword.lead: You will stay signed in here; every other device will be signed out.
changePassword.mustBody: You signed in with a temporary password. Choose a new one before you continue.
changePassword.mismatch: The two new passwords are not the same.

lead.member: Your loans, due dates and library notices will appear here.
lead.admin: Today's work at your branch will appear here.
lead.super_admin: The whole library's work will appear here.

home.fewerThanTwoBody: The library needs at least two active super admins, so that one can always help the other.
home.pendingTitle: Your application is waiting for approval
home.pendingBody: Visit your home branch with proof of identity and the first year's fee. You can browse the catalogue meanwhile.
home.comingBody: Branches, the catalogue, issuing and returns arrive in the next releases.

staff.title: Staff
staff.leadSuper: Every librarian and super admin. Accounts are never deleted; deactivate one to stop it being used.
staff.name: Full name
staff.superAdminNoBranch: A super admin works across every branch.
staff.formIncomplete: Fill in the name, a valid WhatsApp number and, for a librarian, the branch.
staff.tempBody: Give this to the person in private. It is shown only now and cannot be seen again. They must choose their own password when they first sign in.

errors.invalid_credentials: That WhatsApp number and password do not match.
errors.account_locked: Too many failed attempts. Try again in {{minutes}} minutes, or ask a librarian to reset your password.
errors.application_rejected: Your application was not approved. Please contact your branch.
errors.account_deactivated: This account has been deactivated. Please contact the library.
errors.must_change_password: Please choose a new password before continuing.
errors.wrong_current_password: Your current password is not correct.
errors.password_unchanged: The new password must be different from the current one.
errors.password_not_acceptable: Choose a password that meets the rules below.
errors.phone_in_use: An account already uses this WhatsApp number.
errors.minimum_super_admins: At least two super admin accounts must stay active.
errors.cannot_deactivate_self: You cannot deactivate your own account.
errors.use_change_password: Use "Change password" for your own account.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.invalid_request: Some of the information is missing or not valid.
errors.network_error: The server cannot be reached. Check the connection and try again.
errors.internal_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.image_type: Choose a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
errors.image_too_large: The image must be 2 MB or smaller.
errors.image_unreadable: That image could not be read.
errors.branch_code_in_use: Another branch already uses this code.
errors.branch_code_locked: This code is printed on books and can no longer change.
errors.category_code_in_use: Another category already uses this code.
errors.category_code_locked: Books already carry this code, so it can no longer change. The name can.
errors.members_only: Only members have a membership record.
errors.not_pending: This application has already been decided.
errors.not_rejected: Only an application that was not approved can be reopened.
errors.waiver_super_admin_only: Only a super admin can waive the first fee.
errors.cannot_renew: Approve the application first; then the membership can be renewed.
errors.invalid_date_of_birth: The date of birth must be in the past.

images.rules: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB. It is resized and kept inside the system.

branches.title: Branches
branches.lead: Every branch of the library, with its two-letter code.
branches.readOnly: Only a super admin can change these details.
branches.name: Branch name
branches.codeHint: Two capital letters, e.g. KS. It is printed on every book of this branch.
branches.codeLocked: Books already carry this code, so it can no longer change.
branches.formIncomplete: Fill in every field: a two-letter code and a valid phone number.
branches.logoUse: Shown to this branch's members and staff, and on its PDFs. Without one, the library's logo is used.
branches.settingsLead: Changes apply from now on, and are written to the activity log with the old and new values.
branches.settingsReadOnly: Only a super admin can change the settings.

loanDays.label: Loan period (days)
loanDays.hint: Also the length of an extension.

maxBooks.label: Books at a time
maxBooks.hint: The most one member may hold.

maxBooksWhileSettling.label: Books while a loss is open
maxBooksWhileSettling.hint: While a lost book is not yet settled.

holdDays.label: Hold a requested book (days)
holdDays.hint: After it arrives from another branch.

declineGraceDays.label: Grace after a late decline (days)
declineGraceDays.hint: When an extension is declined after the due date.

annualFeeCents.label: Annual fee
annualFeeCents.hint: For payments taken from now on.

renewalGraceDays.label: Renewal grace (days)
renewalGraceDays.hint: Renewing within this keeps the old expiry date.

settlementWindowDays.label: Days to settle a lost book

frequentLateCount.label: Late returns to flag a member

logRetentionMonths.label: Keep the log online (months)
logRetentionMonths.hint: At least 24; older entries are archived, never destroyed.

categories.title: Categories
categories.lead: The letter and digit in every accession number, each with a name members see.
categories.name: Name
categories.codeLocked: Books already carry this code, so it can no longer change. The name can.
categories.formIncomplete: A code is one capital letter and one digit, such as A1, and needs a name.

person.whatsappHint: You will sign in with this number.
person.organisationHint: For example the school you attend.
person.introducerHint: Someone who knows you and whom the library may call.

apply.title: Apply for membership
apply.lead: Fill this in at home. Then visit your branch with proof of identity and the first year’s fee; a librarian will approve you there.
apply.consent: The person who introduced me has agreed to be named and contacted by the library.
apply.privacyBody: The library keeps the details on this form to run your membership, and shows them only to its staff. If your application is not approved within 90 days, your details are removed. (Personal Data Protection Act No. 9 of 2022.)
apply.privacyAccept: I have read this and agree.
apply.incomplete: Please fill in every required field: a valid WhatsApp number, your date of birth, your home branch, and the introducer’s name and phone.

members.title: Members
members.lead: Applications to approve, finding a member, and memberships to renew.
members.searchPlaceholder: Part of a name, or a phone number
members.approveLead: With the applicant here: check their identity document against these details, then take the first year’s fee.
members.identityChecked: I have checked an identity document against these details.
members.rejectReason: Why is this application not approved?
members.rejectedNotice: The application was not approved. The person has been told when they next sign in.
members.feeIncomplete: Enter the amount and the receipt number.
members.reopenLead: It goes back to the waiting list. Personal details are removed 90 days after it was made.
members.renewLead: The membership runs until {{date}}. A year is added from that date, or from today if it lapsed long ago.
members.renewedNotice: Payment recorded. The membership now runs until {{date}}.
members.resetLead: Gives a temporary password, shown once, that must be changed at the next sign-in.
members.exportNote: Every export is written to the activity log.
members.registerLead: For someone who is here at the counter. They are a member at once, with a temporary password.
members.consentAsked: The person confirms their introducer agreed to be named.
members.registerIncomplete: Fill in every required field, tick both boxes, and enter the fee and receipt number.

my.title: My membership
my.lead: Your details as the library holds them. You can change your address, other phone and organisation here.
my.pendingLead: Your application, as the library will see it. You can correct it until it is approved.
my.otherChanges: To change your name, date of birth or WhatsApp number, ask a librarian.
